text: 65 Singing is Fun! 4.3 Betty Botter bought some butter, But, she said, this butter is bitter; If I put it in my batter, It will make my batter bitter. But a bit of better butter will make my batter better. Bunty’s big blue balloon burst. Chintu chews crunchy chocolate. 1. Listen and sing. 2. Practise these tongue twisters. 3. Listen and read.
